brief:
Economic researcher Ahmad Abu Qamr said the approaching winter season adds new financial strain on displaced families across Gaza, as their purchasing power declines and regular income sources disappear, Shehab Wire reported. Abu Qamr pointed to the difficulty of securing adequate shelter amid the economic pressures facing the displaced population.

The researcher emphasized that families lack consistent income sources needed to cover winter expenses, compounding an already severe economic crisis in the territory.

title: Winter 2026 doubles displacement costs for Gaza families, economist warns
